series.title: Prison Break
series.description: Structural engineer Michael Scofield deliberately enters Fox River to break his wrongly condemned brother Lincoln out of prison. The escape becomes a wider battle against the conspiracy behind Lincoln's conviction and, once the walls are behind them, a relentless pursuit across the country.

series.title: Queen of Swords
series.description: After her father's death, aristocrat Tessa Alvarado returns to Spanish California and secretly becomes the masked Queen of Swords, defending ordinary people from Colonel Montoya's corrupt rule while concealing her identity from allies, rivals and dangerous admirers.

series.title: Relic Hunter
series.description: University professor and globe-trotting relic hunter Sydney Fox follows historical clues to recover lost artifacts before thieves, collectors and criminals can exploit them, with researcher Nigel Bailey and her campus assistants supplying scholarship, logistics and occasional rescue.

series.title: Roswell
series.description: Liz Parker learns that Max Evans, his sister Isabel and Michael Guerin are alien-human hybrids after Max saves her life. Their friendships and romances become inseparable from the search for their origins, the 1947 crash and the people determined to expose or control them.

series.title: RoboCop
series.description: Cybernetic police officer RoboCop protects near-future Delta City while OCP repeatedly turns technology, public services and even crime itself into corporate experiments. Beneath the armor, Alex Murphy's memories and surviving family ties keep complicating the machine OCP believes it owns.
